manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: A ball is tossed straight up on a fixed height scale. A Motion arrow shrinks, vanishes at the top and reverses, while the gravity arrow never changes.
assumptions: Gravity fixed at 9.8 m/s^2, no air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.description: A ball rises from a launch mark and falls back. The blue Motion arrow shortens, is absent at the top, then points down. The dashed gravity arrow always points down with the same length.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed, then press Play. Playback pauses at the top.

program.source: export function evaluate({inputs,time}){const g=9.8,u=inputs.launchSpeed;const T=2*u/g;const t=Math.min(Math.max(time,0),T);const ta=u/g;const h=u*t-g*t*t/2;const v=u-g*t;const top=Math.abs(t-ta)<0.012;const st=top?1:(v>0?0:2);const sc=60;const y0=360;const x=300;const py=y0-h*sc;const o=[];o.push(...sdk.panel({id:'lane.toss',x:20,y:40,w:600,h:360,title:'Toss',state:['Moving up','Still for an instant','Moving down'][st]}));o.push(sdk.line('guide',100,y0+16,260,y0+16,{role:'neutral'}));o.push(sdk.text('guide.t',100,y0+40,'Launch height',{role:'neutral'}));o.push(sdk.circle('ball.toss',x,py,26,{role:'observed'}));if(!top)o.push(...sdk.vector('vec.v',{x:x+50,y:py},{value:v,direction:'up'},{scale:20,label:'v',role:'input'}));o.push(...sdk.vector('vec.a',{x:x+110,y:py},{value:-g,direction:'up'},{scale:5,label:'a',role:'warning'}));o.push(...sdk.callout(440,150,['Gravity pulls down',['Moving up','Still for an instant','Moving down'][st]],{id:'callout.toss'}));return{frame:{width:640,height:420,objects:o,readouts:[{id:'motionState',value:['Moving up','Still for an instant','Moving down'][st]},{id:'gravityState',value:'Gravity pulls down'}]},quantities:{launchSpeed:u,gravity:g,apexTime:ta,apexHeight:u*u/(2*g),velocity:v,height:h}};}
